metadata.description: A curated marketplace of Claude Code plugins by Raymond Manaloto. Each plugin is dual-purpose: useful to zero-knowledge users discovering a tool for the first time, and to deep practitioners integrating that tool into their projects. Self-aware via MCP servers, with active SessionStart context nudging where applicable.

plugins.name: mise-toolkit
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin for mise (mise-en-place) — the polyglot dev tool, env, and task manager. Three audiences: zero-knowledge newcomers (install + activate + verify wizard), adopters (mise.toml design, lockfiles, env directives, secrets, tasks, CI, migrations from nvm/pyenv/asdf), and contributors hacking on jdx/mise itself. Bundles mise's own MCP server for live project introspection.
